description:
There is a story that says, if a man never dated until the age of 25, they would become wizards. But it turned out to be true! Lee Sang Nam, who became the 100 millionth magician, lives in a world that is 180 degrees reversed from his original world. That world is called Normal Mode.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/normal_mode), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/50984806), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3306662), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1746005327), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/Normal_5), MeToon, [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_normal_wz), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H036397028), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H036397028)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/111398), [Thai](https://www.wecomics.in.th/comics/8073/)
